verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's own docs say an LLC package includes access to 150+ customizable legal documents, plus an operating agreement, so a founder gets a first-party template library for routine documents. That access is tied to the formation package and limited to 1 year. The evidence never says the templates are attorney-vetted or names NDAs or policies. A lawyer in the community warns that operating agreements are not commodity documents, but that is caution, not a concrete failure, so it does not make this disputed. Missing for 10: evidence that templates are vetted by counsel, named coverage of NDAs, agreements and policies, standalone or ongoing library access beyond 1 year, independent hands-on corroboration of template quality.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents

citations.quote: Access 150+ customizable legal documents for 1 year
An operating agreement, which helps you set entity guidelines and settle disputes
